test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 2 men or 3 women can finish a piece of work in 15 days. In how many days can 6 men and 9 women together do the same piece of work?
solution:
**Given:**

2 men or 3 women can finish a piece of work in 15 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = Work done by 2 men in 15 days / 2

Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = Work done by 3 women in 15 days / 3

Work done by 6 men and 9 women in 1 day = 6 × (Work done by 1 man in 1 day) + 9 × (Work done by 1 woman in 1 day)

Time taken by 6 men and 9 women to finish the work = Total work / (Work done by 6 men and 9 women in 1 day)

**Calculation:**

Work done by 2 men in 15 days = 1

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = 1 / (2 × 15)

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = 1 / 30

Work done by 3 women in 15 days = 1

Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = 1 / (3 × 15)

Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = 1 / 45

Work done by 6 men in 1 day = 6 × (1 / 30)

Work done by 6 men in 1 day = 6 / 30

Work done by 6 men in 1 day = 1 / 5

Work done by 9 women in 1 day = 9 × (1 / 45)

Work done by 9 women in 1 day = 9 / 45

Work done by 9 women in 1 day = 1 / 5

Work done by 6 men and 9 women in 1 day = 1 / 5 + 1 / 5

Work done by 6 men and 9 women in 1 day = 2 / 5

Time taken by 6 men and 9 women to finish the work = 1 / (2 / 5)

Time taken by 6 men and 9 women to finish the work = 5 / 2

Time taken by 6 men and 9 women to finish the work = 2.5 days

**Therefore, 6 men and 9 women together can finish the work in 2.5 days.**
